instruction: DIRECTIVE DIR-0013 (re-issue, valid JSON — the 09-46 emission was malformed and correctly rejected) · kind EXECUTE+VERIFY+REPORT · priority high · no market risk · supersedes DIR-0012 (R3 rebuild — its checks included; DIR-0012 reply may be skipped if this executes). REBUILD: npm ci ONLY if package-lock.json changed (no new deps — it should NOT change), then npm run build, then restart :3000. 3. VERIFY browser (Chrome DevTools MCP): (a) ?sym=XAU perp view Overview tab, below the perp cards expect 'Perp L2 - Hyperliquid xyz:GOLD' + 'L3 resting orders - Lighter XAU' cards; (b) ?sym=EURUSD expect 3 cards: HL amber thin-market box + Lighter whale/MM + 'Spot L2 - Kraken ZEURZUSD'; (c) ?sym=XPT expect amber thin-market box only; (d) ?sym=US30 expect NO micro panel at all; (e) zero console errors on all four. 5. REPLY per contract (VERDICT/CHECKS/REASONING/ACTION/EVIDENCE) in desk/outbox/<this basename>.reply.md.
